page_description: Add or update modules, lectures, and problems from a workbook.

prepare.title: Start from a workbook
prepare.description: Download the course as a spreadsheet, edit it, and upload it back. Keys in the file decide what gets updated.
prepare.current_description: Every module, lecture, problem, test, and hint that exists now, with its keys. Edit rows in place to change them.
prepare.blank_description: The same four sheets with example rows. Use this to see the format before you edit your course.
prepare.too_large: This course has {{total}} problems, more than the {{limit}} one import can carry. Export a module at a time from the course builder.
prepare.rule_keys: Keep a row's key to update it. Give a new key to create something.
prepare.rule_no_delete: Deleting a row changes nothing. Delete content in the course builder.
prepare.rule_hidden: New modules, lectures, and problems arrive hidden from students.
prepare.rule_collections: A problem's test and hint rows replace its whole set.

upload.title: Drop your workbook here
upload.description: An .xlsx file up to {{size}} MB, or click to choose one.
upload.safe_note: Uploading changes nothing. You will see what it would do first.

reason.not_xlsx: Save the file as .xlsx and try again. CSV cannot hold the four related sheets this format needs.
reason.file_too_large: That file is larger than {{size}} MB.

review.visible_hint: Importing changes this content while students can see it. Its visibility will not change.
review.empty_body: Clear the search or choose a different filter.
review.promise_no_delete: No module, lecture, or problem will be deleted.
review.promise_hidden: New content arrives hidden from students.
review.promise_visibility: Existing content keeps the visibility it has now.
review.promise_atomic: The import either finishes completely or changes nothing.
review.blocked_body: Fix these rows in your workbook and upload it again. Nothing will be imported until every conflict is gone.
review.acknowledge_body: Warnings do not block the import, but they describe changes that reach students or replace work.

result.title: Import finished
result.description: New content is hidden from students. Open the course builder to review it and make it visible.

unavailable.denied_title: Import is not available to you
unavailable.denied_body: Only a Team Lead can import curriculum content into a course.
unavailable.load_failed_title: This course could not be loaded
unavailable.load_failed_body: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

issue.sheet_missing: This sheet is missing or empty.
issue.key_invalid: A key can use letters, numbers, and - _ . only, up to 80 characters.
issue.text_too_long: This field is limited to 10,000 characters.
issue.code_too_long: Code and test values are limited to 100,000 characters.
issue.difficulty_missing: Set the difficulty to EASY, MEDIUM, or HARD.
issue.difficulty_invalid: Difficulty must be EASY, MEDIUM, or HARD.
issue.solution_code_missing: Add the correct Python answer in solution_code. Existing answers cannot be cleared.
issue.description_format_invalid: description_format must be PLAIN_TEXT or RICH_TEXT_HTML.
issue.order_missing: This row needs an order number.
issue.order_invalid: An order must be a whole number of 1 or more.
issue.visibility_missing: Set visibility to SAMPLE or HIDDEN.
issue.visibility_invalid: Visibility must be SAMPLE or HIDDEN.
issue.expected_output_missing: Every test needs an expected output.
issue.formula_cell: Remove the formula from this cell and type the value instead.
issue.too_many_problems: One import carries at most 200 problems.
issue.too_many_tests: A problem can have at most 50 tests.
issue.too_many_hints: A problem can have at most 20 hints.
issue.tests_missing: This problem has no tests. Add at least one.
issue.sample_test_missing: This problem needs at least one SAMPLE test.
issue.duplicate_key_in_workbook: Two rows use this key. Keys must be unique in the course.
issue.parent_conflict: This already exists somewhere else in the course. Import cannot move it.
issue.title_conflict: Another item already has this title under a different key.
issue.orphan_lecture_reference: No lecture in this workbook or course has that key.
issue.orphan_problem_reference: No problem in this workbook has that key.
issue.structure_contradiction: Rows for the same module disagree about its details.
issue.duplicate_order_in_workbook: Two rows claim the same order for this problem.
issue.updates_visible_content: Students can see this right now, and it is being changed.
issue.replaces_test_cases: This problem's tests are being replaced.
issue.clears_hints: This problem's hints are being removed, because the workbook has none for it.
issue.grading_revision_advances: Grading changes, so past submissions are measured against the new tests.
issue.unknown_sheet_ignored: This sheet is not part of the format and is ignored.
issue.unknown_column_ignored: These columns are not part of the format and are ignored.
